title: Elf Bar Dual 10K Fruity Edition Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Fruity Edition Pre Filled Pods for the Elf Bar Dual 10K bring together two vibrant fruit blends in perfect balance. One pod delivers the orchard-fresh pairing of Apple Pear - crisp, juicy and mellow. The second pod features the exotic fusion of Kiwi Passionfruit Guava, bursting with tropical sharpness and sweet-tart complexity. Each pod is Pre Filled with 2ml of e-liquid and supported by an integrated 5ml refill reservoir. The Elf Bar Dual 10K automatic refill system keeps both flavours running smoothly without messy top-ups. If you're after a pairing that blends classic and tropical fruits with clean intensity, Fruity Edition is a strong contender in the line-up. How to Use: 1. Remove the Sticker and Read the Instructions 2. Remove the Silicone Parts and the Bottom Sticker 3. Press both containers securely into place 4. Install the pod into the Dual 10K device to use
